commitResults.messageBody:
The starter project uses the Duke name and branding.

Rename the entry point and documentation to Groot, and replace the
banner to give the chatbot a consistent identity.

The chatbot only displays its banner and does not address the user.

Add a greeting, prompt, separators, and farewell to give each session a
clear beginning and end.

The chatbot exits immediately after greeting the user.

Read and echo commands until the user enters `bye` so a session can
support continuous interaction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add in-memory task storage and listing
commitResults.messageBody:
Echoed commands are not retained, so users cannot review earlier input.

Store task descriptions in memory and add the `list` command to display
them in insertion order.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add command to mark tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Stored tasks do not record whether they have been completed.

Track completion state and add the `mark` command so users can update
and view a task status. Ignore generated Java build output as well.

Users can mark a task as done but cannot correct that status later.

Add the `unmark` command so a completed task can be returned to its
pending state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate task state in Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Task descriptions and completion flags are stored in parallel arrays,
which can become inconsistent as task behavior grows.

Introduce a Task class that owns its description, completion state,
status updates, and display format. Store Task objects in one array.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add todo, deadline, and event task types
commitResults.messageBody:
All tasks share one generic representation, so dated tasks lose their
meaning and display details.

Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses and parse their respective
input formats. Record UI tests to verify polymorphic storage and status
updates.

Malformed commands can terminate the chatbot or corrupt task state.

Validate task details and task numbers, and report input problems
through a dedicated GrootException without ending the session. Add UI
coverage for invalid commands and confirm rejected input does not alter
stored tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task deletion with dynamic storage
commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks are stored in a fixed-size array, which complicates deletion and
capacity management.

Use an ArrayList to manage tasks. Add the `delete` command so users can
remove tasks by number, validate deletion input, and report the updated
task count.

Update the documentation and UI tests to cover task reindexing, retained
status, invalid input, and deletion from an empty list.

Command keywords are repeated as strings throughout parsing, which makes
the supported command set difficult to manage consistently.

Introduce CommandType to centralize keywords and argument rules.
Dispatch commands through the enum so invalid inputs remain distinct
from supported commands.

Extend UI tests with command boundary cases. Prevent invalid list or bye
arguments from changing or ending the session.

The README does not explain how AI tools contributed to the project.

Add an AI use section that records Codex's role in design,
implementation, testing, documentation, and Git maintenance. Clarify
that suggestions were reviewed and verified using Java 25 UI tests.
